seed_meaning: three independent full ICBHI source trainings; encoder, N/C/W head, patient head, pair sampling and batch order all vary

assets.trained_checkpoint_status: no local PC-MCL-trained source checkpoint found

source_training.split: official recording split: official train for optimization, official test for epochwise source selection
source_training.train_pair_input: each constituent cycle repeat-padded or center-cropped to 2.5 s, then waveform-concatenated to exactly 5 s
source_training.single_unit_input: repeat-pad or center-crop the single cycle to exactly 5 s
source_training.patient_target: same patient positive; different patient with matched pathology profile hard negative
source_training.early_stopping: strict ICBHI source Score improvement; patience 10; min_delta 0; tie counts as no improvement
source_training.lr_schedule: step decay at epochs 15 and 20 by factor 0.1, preserving the original 120/160 relative positions
source_training.specaugment_candidate_from_official_code: enabled by default for BEATs unless --nospec
source_training.selection: strict maximum ICBHI official-test Score with source-code sensitivity > 0.1 gate; exact tie keeps earlier epoch
source_training.selection_boundary: test-selected source reproduction-style diagnostic, not clean validation-only evidence

source_code_delta.required_patch: official --desired_length 5 only normalizes the final concatenation; use build_pcmcl_pair_5s so each constituent is independently normalized to 2.5 s before concatenation
source_code_delta.loss_patch: replace the source code convex ssl_weight mixture with exact L_main + 0.1 L_patient

post_selection_freeze: freeze encoder, N/C/W classifier, patient classifier and threshold; no target adaptation or readout selection

sprsound.unit: official inter BioCAS event, prepared as one 5-s unit
sprsound.readout: N/C/W probabilities -> fixed 0.5 C/W bits -> ICBHI flat4 -> Normal versus any abnormal

hf.unit: three fixed 5-s windows per source-test recording
hf.target: Wheeze/Rhonchi/Stridor positive and D-only negative in the fixed eligible pool
hf.boundary: Wheeze-head ranking proxy, not a complete CAS detector

kauh.unit: B/D/E recording views followed by P-number aggregation
kauh.patient_score: mean of the three B/D/E view scores
kauh.support: 86 patients with compatible source labels; Crep, Bronchial and I C B excluded

transfer: fixed readout prediction or ranking score
raw target loaded only for terminal scoring
reporting.aggregate: mean and sample standard deviation over three independent source-training seeds

budget.training_cache: none; encoder updates require waveform-to-model training
budget.approximate_examples_per_epoch: about 1.8 times source cycles from original, mixed and patient samples
budget.checkpoint_storage: about one BEATs-sized model state per best/last artifact; optimizer resume state is materially larger
budget.runtime: not measured; no profile or forward was run

comparison_boundary.paper_10s: published 10-s PC-MCL results cannot substitute for this 5-s source model
comparison_boundary.main_comparator: LSAA main model trained jointly on ICBHI and SPRSound
comparison_boundary.source_difference: ICBHI-only PC-MCL versus joint-source LSAA is the intended system comparison and must be disclosed, not removed by adding matching experiments
comparison_boundary.existing_icbhi_only_lsaa: remains only in the pre-existing ablation table; it is not the main comparator, a required control, or a new task for this PC-MCL baseline
comparison_boundary.transfer_interpretation: target differences may reflect representation, label coverage, input adaptation and fixed readout; they are not attributable to N/C/W alone
